notes.note: Harley had a tag from Stone who was a late in for Bedford this week. He still had 8 clearances and 25 disposals.
Reid copped a large cork to the quad early in the game but did run it out. He ended with 7 kicks 22 handballs and 5 free kicks against. This is a watch to see if he is good to go next week.
Harley put on a show for the Eagles with 20 contested possessions and 9 clearances from his 34 disposals while he was on the right side of the free kick count for a change with 6 in his favour.
Reid got a little fiery early but settled to end with 30 disposals and he led the game in contested possessions with 15 and clearance with 12 but 10 clangers was part that really hurt his score.

Harley left the game in the first after getting his ankle stepped on but did return after quarter time and finished with a game high 10 clearances and he added 23 disposals and 15 contested possessions. He ran out the game and hopefully is fine for this week.
Harley had some huge moments in a very impressive game as he racked up 16 contested possessions and 9 clearances from his 27 disposals. This was his first over 100 since round 10.

Harley gave away 6 free kicks which really hurt his score as did his 52% efficiency. This really hurt his score as he did have 18 contested possessions and 6 clearances. Yet to have a ton in his last 6 games.
Reid was one of the few shining lights for the Eagles as he led the game in clearances with 12 but he gave away 4 free kicks which hurt. This extended his below 100 scoring streak to 5 games.

Reid posted another of his low scores this week as he fell back into the habit of giving away free kicks as there were four this week. He also had 7 clangers. He will have games like this so don't panic.
Reid was quiet in the second term but did come good in the last term as the Eagles made their charge. He matched last week's score and is still looking a good option.
After a big second quarter Reid had a quiet second half with just 24 points coming from it. He wasn't helped by giving away 4 free kicks. Good return to scoring after the previous week's drop.

Reid had 20 disposals and he gave away 4 free kicks. This broke his run of 100+ scores and he also delivered his second lowest score of the season. If you own no need to trade out based on this one game.
Harley Reid not only went over 100 for three games in a row now but he posted a massive game with 34 disposals 8 tackles and 19 clearances and 10 clearances.
Reid had his first back to back scores over 100 this week from his 21 disposals coming at 81% and a goal. Importantly he gave away just the 1 free kick this week.
Harley posted his second over 100 for the season with his 26 disposals and 2 goals but it could have been so much more as he had 11 clangers and gave away 5 free kicks.

Reid was tagged by Garcia and had 19 of his 27 disposals by hand. He still led his team in clearances with 7. His scoring is not looking like reaching heights so this is about what we can expect from him.
Reid continues to give us middling type scores. He is going to find it tough in the Eagles side to score well unfortunately. 20 touches at 65% for him as it was tough in the Derby.
22 disposals and a goal for Harley to go with a goal. He is going to continue to get attention from the opposition and he seems to have settled in this scoring zone rather than going big.
Reid was tagged by Jordon for the game and became very frustrated ending with 17 disposals at 64%. He is susceptible to a tag so these scores could come more often.
Reid has put in his best score of the year which was aided by 2 goals. He is getting the highest CBAs for his side this year at 86%.
30 touches for Harley but 3 frees against and 9 clangers really dragged that score down.
Reid again had his issues with the umpires giving away 3 free kicks.
